lead.headline: Boxlight insiders filed 30 of 76 stock-sale reports late; 38 of 2,740 companies ran 10%+ late; median zero
lead.number: 38 of 2,740 companies with 30+ sale reports had 10%+ filed 11-365 days late (22 under the strict rule); 90th percentile 2.9%
lead.watch_out: A late sale report is a paperwork failure, not proof of insider trading; co-owners filing the same trade twice can fake lateness (55 such mirrors were dropped).
